title: Baked fish with tomatoes and olives
summary: Baked fish with tomatoes and olives is a mediterranean dinner built around haddock fillets and cherry tomatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Baked fish with tomatoes and olives into even pieces and toss cherry tomatoes with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of cherry tomatoes while you season haddock fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle haddock fillets and pitted black olives among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Baked fish with tomatoes and olives before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Baked fish with tomatoes and olives into warm bowls with the juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
